summary: Completed testing of OhmGuard Advanced Event Workflow features. All 15 features tested successfully. Backend: PATCH /events with mandatory comment validation, user assignment with name storage, GET /users/assignable, GET /events/{id}/comments all working. Frontend: EventActionDialog shared component working correctly with mandatory comment fields for RESOLVED/FALSE_ALARM, optional assignment dropdown for ACK/ASSIGN, CC admin checkbox. GlobalAlertBanner, LivePage, and EventDetailPage all integrate properly with EventActionDialog. Assigned user name badge (purple) visible in alert rows.
passed_tests: Backend: PATCH /api/events/{id} with status=RESOLVED without comment returns 400 error
Backend: PATCH /api/events/{id} with status=FALSE_ALARM without comment returns 400 error
Backend: PATCH /api/events/{id} with status=ACK without comment succeeds (optional)
Backend: PATCH /api/events/{id} with status=RESOLVED and comment succeeds
Backend: PATCH /api/events/{id} with assigned_to stores assigned_to_name
Backend: GET /api/users/assignable returns users with correct roles (SUPER_ADMIN/TENANT_ADMIN/SUPERVISOR/OPERATOR)
Backend: GET /api/events/{id}/comments returns comments array with correct structure
Frontend: Clicking 'Resoudre' opens EventActionDialog with mandatory comment field (*)
Frontend: Clicking 'Fausse alarme' opens EventActionDialog with mandatory comment
Frontend: Clicking 'Acquitter' opens EventActionDialog with optional comment + assignment dropdown
Frontend: Clicking 'Assigner' opens EventActionDialog with user dropdown + CC admin checkbox
Frontend: EventActionDialog shows event info summary (type badge, location, sensor)
Frontend: Global Alert Banner shows assigned user name badge (purple) - 'Jean Martin'
Frontend: Event Detail page shows 'Assigné a' card with user name
Frontend: Event Detail page shows 'Historique des actions' comments section
Frontend: Event Detail page has Assigner button
Frontend: Live Page alert cards have Assigner button (6 buttons found)
Frontend: Live Page Active Alerts Section visible with detailed alert cards
critical_code_review_comments: EventActionDialog correctly requires comment for RESOLVED and FALSE_ALARM actions via config
EventActionDialog correctly makes comment optional for ACK and ASSIGN actions
Backend correctly validates mandatory comment via HTTP 400 response with French error message
Assignment stores both assigned_to (user ID) and assigned_to_name (user full name)
Comments stored in event.comments array with proper structure (id, user_name, user_role, text, action, created_at)
usersAPI.assignable() correctly fetches users with allowed roles
GlobalAlertBanner displays assigned_to_name as purple badge in alert rows
Event Detail page displays 'Assigné a' card only when assigned_to_name is present
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test FALL events via /api/create-fall-event endpoint. Some assigned to 'Admin Système' with comments.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Advanced event workflow fully implemented and tested. Key components: EventActionDialog.jsx (shared dialog with config-driven mandatory/optional fields), GlobalAlertBanner.jsx (displays assigned_to_name badge), LivePage.js ActiveAlertsSection (alert cards with all action buttons), EventDetailPage.js (shows Assigné a card and Historique des actions). Backend endpoints: PATCH /api/events/{id} (validates mandatory comment for RESOLVED/FALSE_ALARM), GET /api/users/assignable (returns assignable users), GET /api/events/{id}/comments (returns comments array). Email notifications are MOCKED (SMTP not configured in test env - will log warning).
